ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 95:5 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels to high-intensity (white/glare) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous black pixel mass covering the entire visible fluke surface; high-contrast white pixel clusters localized at the distal tips and scattered as individual focal points across the mid-lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression; internal pixel angle approximately 45 degrees with a vertical depth extending significantly into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge; notable high-amplitude jagged protrusion on the inner-left lobe relative to the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong concave curvature originating from the median notch and sweeping upward and outward to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of circular, high-intensity white pixel aggregates (barnacle colonization) concentrated heavily on the left and right distal trailing edges and sporadically across the ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the lobe tips and an irregular, possibly traumatic, notch on the inner-left margin adjacent to the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense fringe of white calcified organisms along the leading and trailing edges of the distal tips.
